sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Despite that defeat, Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, holding a two-point lead over second-placed Stafford Town. Alsager are struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points, so this presents a golden opportunity for the leaders to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town, a fixture that could see them close the gap on Sandbach if they win. AFC Bridgnorth, third on 19 points, travel to Eccleshall in what looks a competitive mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, welcome Wednesfield Community to what should be a closely contested encounter. Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) face Foley Meir at home in a fixture between mid-table sides. Barnton host Shawbury United—Barnton are in form with back-to-back wins, while Shawbury have lost their last six games. Market Drayton Town, winless in their last two, travel to face New Mills, who have won their most recent outing. Brereton Social are at home to Widnes Town, who prop up the division with just 2 points and are in dire form. Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town in a basement-battle clash between two of the league's weakest performers. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home, with both sides fighting to avoid the drop zone.
